'''Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent''' was a criminal organization founded and led by the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hylo Visz]]. Visz had previously worked for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], but after a botched smuggling run, she left the Cartel's service and struck out on her own. She formed the smuggling ring during the [[Great Galactic War]], and led it in an unofficial alliance with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3661 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian warrior clans]] blockaded the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] on behalf of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. As the blockade choked commerce in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and stifled the Republic's ability to wage war, prices for raw goods skyrocketed. Seeing the blockade as an opportunity for incredible profit, Visz and her fellow smugglers organized an attack on the Mandalorian forces. After loading [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] with goods collected from across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the smugglers piloted the ships directly towards the blockade. While distracted by the freighters, the Mandalorians were attacked by the contingent's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of small smuggling vessels. With the aid of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], the gambit was successful, and the blockade was broken. Visz was highly rewarded by the Republic for her efforts, and hailed as a hero upon her arrival on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
